text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Um. Trainer.
choice_data_list: Is that an invitation to take a detour?
Is that an invitation to take a detour?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Hehe, did you notice that I've been 
a bit restless for a while now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"As I walk with you, maybe we'll find 
something wonderful again... Just thinking 
about it makes my heart dance."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And as Mejiro Ardan and I continued our 
leisurely stroll—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan stopped in front of a 
greengrocer in the shopping district, 
staring intently at something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Don't you think this apple 
looks absolutely delicious?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction indicated, there 
was indeed a row of rich red apples that 
looked absolutely ripe and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy a few. Please wait a moment, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now then... With that done, let's resume 
our detour♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is she thinking of going to a park 
somewhere to eat apples, perhaps?" With 
that thought in mind, I follow after her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Surprisingly, Mejiro Ardan's legs carried 
her straight to the Academy, and she ended 
up arriving at the Trainer's office.
choice_data_list: Huh... Aren't we taking a detour?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a silly thing to say. This is a 
perfectly splendid detour, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Normally, after an outing, we'd dismiss 
once reaching the academy. Yet here we 
are, stopping by with souvenirs, aren't 
we?
choice_data_list: I guess that's just how it is...
Is that how it works, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is indeed how it works♪ Now then, 
allow me to peel it right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now, please enjoy your meal.
choice_data_list: Thank you for the food.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
――"An apple a day keeps the doctor away." 
As the proverb goes, apples are a fruit of 
exceptional nutritional value.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, my nanny has peeled apples for 
me many times since I was little. I'm 
quite confident in my eye for delicious 
apples."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —How about it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad. I love this flavor, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...At the same time, it's also a fruit 
that leaves me with mixed feelings 
whenever I eat it."
choice_data_list: Why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I was fed apples, it was 
usually... when I was sick in bed or 
staying in the hospital."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"And at times like that, the gentle, 
comforting taste of the peeled apples 
Nanny gave me... that was what apples 
tasted like to me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—It felt as though reality was slowly, 
gradually sinking in with every bite.
choice_data_list: Then why now...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I simply wanted to make sure. Thinking 
that perhaps now, it might taste 
different."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now that I can run again, I can also enjoy 
wonderful little detours with you. With 
who I am now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Sip)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: How is it?
What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—This sweetness hasn't changed since I was 
a child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... right now, I feel this 
sweetness stirs up feelings in me that I 
never had before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Vitality and courage. A flavor that, 
together with the fine folks supporting 
me, gives the strength to confront any 
adversity—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...If I were eating this apple all alone 
right now, I'm certain it wouldn't taste 
anything like this."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's truly wondrous. Both the 
little things and the steep paths look 
entirely different when experienced 
together.
choice_data_list:
I'd love to keep taking all kinds of 
detours with you.

It'd be nice to keep taking all kinds of 
detours together.
I'll join you anytime, for anything!

I'll accompany you anytime, for whatever 
it is!

Looks like that was a nice little 
breather.

Looks like that was a nice little 
breather, huh?

text_block_list.text:

little things and the steep paths look 
entirely different when experienced 
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please. I'm truly looking forward to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...To me, every single race could be my 
last, something worth betting everything 
on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... simply thinking about a 
peaceful and joyful tomorrow... That, too, 
is a wonderful thing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes. I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No matter what trials we may face, let us 
join hands and cooperate to overcome them 
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Still... if you ever get tired.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Though... I might end up leaning on you 
just a little bit from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. This detour turned out to be quite 
lovely as well♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"It's precisely because we have moments 
like this that I can properly reset my 
mindset and focus on my goals."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In a race, I simply look at the goal and 
run. I have no hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that too... there must be wonderful 
things waiting that only the two of us can 
experience.
